resumo:
Software engineer building SaaS for river transportation and port management in the Amazon. I am part of the team that designed and keeps developing an ecosystem connecting ticket e-commerce, port management, financial control and physical access control, serving shipping companies, travel agencies, ports and passengers. I currently balance my main role at W3 Companhia with freelance projects, delivering consistent technical work.

Key contributions:
• Modernized sales processes, creating a more efficient experience for sellers and buyers.
• Faster, more efficient reports, especially over large data volumes.
• Security and consistency improvements that reduced anomalies and increased software reliability.
• Strategic new features that increased operational efficiency and revenue.
afinidades: Optimizing and solving complex SQL queries
Coding challenges focused on logic and algorithms
Analyzing and refactoring code for performance

experiencias.empresa: O Mentor Concursos, Taboão da Serra/SP
experiencias.descricao:
• Took part in the launch of the new Mentor in November 2026, for a base of almost 8,000 students.
• Built Mentor's Study Cycle, which spreads each student's subjects across the week based on the routine entered during onboarding and renews automatically through a queue, with its business rules validated by mutation testing.
• Restructured the tools behind Agente Águia's AI chat, including semantic search, flashcard generation and study summaries.
• Built Agente Águia's question module, with a question and exam bank, AI-powered automatic extraction and LLM-generated teaching comments.
• Integrated the question bank into Mentor, creating free-study sessions with filters and topics pre-selected from the student's history.

• Built **Iara**, an AI assistant that answers the team's questions about projects, balances and payments by querying the database. Each person only sees the projects they coordinate.
• Integrated bank reconciliation with the Banco do Brasil and Sicredi APIs. Statements come straight from the banks and each entry is matched against the payments approved in the system, which ended the manual import of statement files.
• Automated daily statement syncing with a day-by-day balance check, reprocessing mismatched periods to catch reversals and fees posted late.
• Integrated project investments and redemptions with Banco do Brasil's Funds API, with safeguards so no operation is ever recorded twice.
• Implemented AI document checks that verify whether attachments match the request and notify the beneficiary of any mismatch, and that read new projects' contracts to fill in their records.
• Built the API that serves projects, budget lines, contracts and reports to other systems. Calls are signed with HMAC, and each key has its own permissions and can be rotated without interrupting the integrations.

• Architected TechRios (SaaS ERP for river transportation): restructured the trips, routes and data pipeline modules, driving +36.7% in transactions vs. 2024.
• Built Porto Fácil, a port management REST API consumed by multiple systems and physical turnstiles, cutting fee reconciliation from hours to minutes.
• Architected the whole Yjara Viagens API (ticket e-commerce), including online payments. Went live in Jun/2025 with +44% in transaction volume.
• Embedded AI into TechRios operations: sales assistance based on the passenger's history and an **in-house MCP server** for natural-language business queries.
• Evolved **W3Zap**, an omnichannel CRM (WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger) based on Ticketz: official WhatsApp API, template campaigns, **AI agents in automations** and voice calls with multi-user management.
• Integrated external systems such as **Dropbox, BP-e (SEFAZ), Safe2Pay and Sicredi**.
• Technologies: PHP, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node, Vue, Laravel, Inertia, CSS, MySQL.

• Built full-stack web features with PHP and JavaScript.
• Optimized database queries and structures for efficiency.
• Technologies: PHP, JavaScript, TypeScript, jQuery, Ajax, Node, Vue, Laravel, Inertia, CSS, MySQL.

projetos.nome: TechRios – SaaS ERP for river transportation
projetos.descricao: SaaS ERP for shipping companies: companies, agencies, trips, routes, reports and tax invoicing (BP-e/SEFAZ), with AI sales assistance and an MCP server for natural-language queries. +36.7% in transactions vs. 2024.

pagina.subtitulo: SaaS ERP that runs the operation of shipping companies in the Amazon, from ticket sales to the electronic tax ticket.

prints.legenda: BI dashboard: revenue, tickets sold, average ticket and occupancy per vessel.
Counter sale: the agent picks seats on the vessel map.
TechRios public website.

visao: TechRios is the management system used by shipping companies and river travel agencies. Each company registers its vessels, lines and trips, and sells tickets at the counter, through partner agencies and through the **Yjara Viagens** e-commerce, which uses the same API.

Beyond sales, the system handles partnerships, cancellations and rebookings, **BP-e** issuing (the Brazilian electronic passenger ticket) with SEFAZ, finance and a BI dashboard with the operation numbers.
fiz: Architected the restructuring of the trips, routes and data pipeline modules, the basis of +36.7% growth in transactions vs. 2024.
Brought AI into the operation: sales assistance based on passenger history and an **in-house MCP server** for business queries in natural language.
Integrated external systems such as **BP-e (SEFAZ), Safe2Pay, Sicredi and Dropbox**.
Architected the whole API of Yjara Viagens, the e-commerce that sells through TechRios, including online payments. Go-live in Jun/2025, with +44% in transaction volume.

resultados.rotulo: in Yjara Viagens transaction volume after go-live

funcionalidades: Vessels, lines, trips and routes, with seat maps and accommodations (hammock, seat, cabin).
Sales at the counter, through partner agencies and through the e-commerce, with real-time seat reservation.
BP-e issuing and communication with SEFAZ.
Partnerships, discounts, cancellations and rebookings.
Finance with PIX billing and bank integration.
BI dashboard: revenue, average ticket, occupancy per route and revenue per vessel.
Multi-tenant: companies, branches and agencies, each with its own permissions and branding.
AI assistant and MCP server for natural-language queries.

projetos.descricao: River and bus ticket e-commerce built on the TechRios API. I architected the whole API, including online payments. Went live in Jun/2025 with +44% in transaction volume.

pagina.subtitulo: Online store for boat and bus tickets in the Amazon, selling the trips of TechRios companies with PIX or card payments.

prints.legenda: Home: trip search and super deals.
Search results: the day’s trips per vessel, with time, duration and price.
Choosing the accommodation, with free and sold seats in real time.

visao: Yjara Viagens is the online store for the region’s river and bus trips: passengers search the route, pick the trip and accommodation, fill in their details and pay with PIX or card, without going to the port.
The whole catalog comes from the **TechRios API**: the same trips, prices and seats that companies sell at the counter show up on the site, and the same API serves agency sites, affiliates and apps.
fiz: Architected the whole e-commerce API that took TechRios ticket sales online, from search to ticket issuing. After going live in June 2025, transaction volume grew 44%.
Made a single API serve many stores, such as agency sites, affiliates and apps, with public OpenAPI docs for partners to integrate.
Integrated online payment by PIX and card through Safe2Pay and Mercado Pago, with saved cards so customers can buy again without re-entering their details.
Put **ClickBus** bus tickets in the same cart as boat trips, so customers buy both in one purchase.
funcionalidades: Trip search by origin, destination and date, filtered by time, accommodation and company.
Accommodation choice (seat, hammock, cabin) with free and sold places in real time.
Cart with boat and bus trips.
PIX or card payment, with saved cards.
Travel insurance and partnerships at checkout.
Super deals, events and most searched destinations.
Customer area with orders and tickets.

projetos.descricao: AI study platform for public-service exams, with a question and exam bank, LLM-generated teaching comments and a chat that runs semantic search, creates flashcards and summarizes content.

pagina.subtitulo: AI study platform for civil service exams: a question bank and a chat that searches the course materials, creates flashcards and summarizes content.

prints.legenda: Agente Águia chat: it summarizes the content and creates flashcards from the conversation.
Flashcard library: learning, review, weak spots and daily cards, per subject.
Spaced repetition: the student reveals the answer and marks it as wrong, good or easy.

visao: Agente Águia is an AI study platform for exam candidates: a question and exam bank with LLM-generated teaching comments and a chat that talks about the course materials.
In the chat, students ask for summaries, get answers through **semantic search** over the materials and turn the conversation into flashcards that go into spaced repetition.
fiz: Automated filling the question bank with AI, which extracts the questions straight from the exam PDF instead of typing them one by one.
Built the AI-generated teacher comment, which explains how to solve each question by searching the web and reading the images in the question.
Built the flow where the teaching team reviews and approves each question before it reaches students, with a 1–10 difficulty suggested by AI from the course materials.
Restructured the AI study chat, which now searches the course materials only when the question needs it and creates summaries and flashcards inside the conversation.
funcionalidades: Question and exam bank with filters.
LLM-generated teaching comments.
Chat with semantic search over the course materials.
Summaries and flashcards created by the chat.
Spaced-repetition flashcards, weak spots and a daily deck.
Question approval panel for the team.

projetos.nome: O Mentor App – Routine and study management for exam candidates
projetos.descricao: Mentoring platform for public-service exam candidates, integrated with Agente Águia and launched in November 2026 for almost 8,000 students. I worked on the Laravel backend and the Next.js frontend for onboarding, routine planning and the study cycle.

Routine: work, sleep and appointments on the calendar, with study blocks fitted in.

visao: Mentor follows the exam candidate from the official notice to the daily routine: the student sets the exam, the time available and their commitments, and the platform builds the weekly study plan and cycle.
The new version launched in November 2026 to a base of almost 8,000 students and brings in the **Agente Águia** question bank.
fiz: Got the new version ready for its launch to almost 8,000 students in November 2026, removing the N+1 queries Sentry flagged on the most used endpoints.
Developed the Study Cycle, which turns each student’s routine into a weekly subject plan and renews itself at the turn of the week.
Built the routine calendar where students log work, sleep and shift schedules, and study blocks fit in without conflicts.
Integrated the Agente Águia question bank into Mentor, with free practice sessions that suggest topics from the student’s history.
funcionalidades: Onboarding that collects the exam, routine and availability.
Weekly study cycle with progression and review per subject.
Calendar routine with work, sleep, shifts and appointments.
Exam syllabus checklist and study plan.
Free practice questions filtered by subject, topic and exam board.
Automatic cycle renewal at the turn of the week.

projetos.descricao: Port management REST API consumed by multiple systems and by physical access-control turnstiles, cutting fee reconciliation from hours to minutes.

pagina.subtitulo: Port management system that charges boarding fees, controls access through turnstiles and integrates with ticket sales systems.

prints.legenda: Porto Fácil website.
The system: fee report per vessel and fee type.
Features: fee issuing, berthing, access control, anti-fraud and reports.

visao: Porto Fácil handles boarding fee collection and access control at river ports and terminals. The city or the port operator registers companies, vessels and fees, and every ticket sold already carries the port fee.
The **REST API** is used by TechRios, Yjara Viagens and other sales systems, and also by **physical turnstiles**, which validate the ticket at the boarding gate.
fiz: Have developed Porto Fácil since 2023, which cities and port operators use to charge port fees per company, vessel and route, taking fee reconciliation from hours to minutes.
Kept boarding working **without internet**: the turnstile agent validates tickets offline and syncs when the connection is back.
Designed the API that connects Porto Fácil to TechRios, other ticket sales systems and the turnstiles, accepting the codes each integrator already uses.
Built the Navegante module, which gathers agencies’ daily sales by city and channel and gives the Navy access to trip dispatch.
funcionalidades: Companies, vessels, routes and fees, with exemptions.
Boarding fees issued on their own or together with the ticket sale.
Ticket validation at the turnstiles, even without internet.
Company billing through PIX, WhatsApp and email.
Financial reports per company, fee type and period.
Public sign-up for cities and port operators.
Navegante module to follow sales and trips.

projetos.nome: W3Zap – AI-powered omnichannel customer service CRM
projetos.descricao: Customer service CRM for WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger, built on Ticketz and adapted to W3's operations, with the official WhatsApp API, segmented campaigns, AI agents in automations and voice calls.

pagina.subtitulo: Customer service CRM that brings WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger into one queue, with AI agents in the automations.

prints.legenda: W3Zap website.
Features: voice calls, multiple connections, customer history, automated service, campaigns and metrics.
How the AI agent solves tickets: triage, context, system lookups and handoff to a human.

visao: W3Zap is the customer service hub for W3 operations: WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger messages land in the same queue, split by department and agent.
It was built on top of the open-source **Ticketz** and adapted to W3 operations, with the official WhatsApp API, segmented campaigns, AI agents in the automations and voice calls.
fiz: Deployed AI bots per connection that answer from each client company’s own documents, query external systems and hand the conversation to an agent with the ticket summary ready.
Built an onboarding assistant over **MCP** that reads the client’s documentation and sets up the service automations on its own.
Gave clients the option of the official WhatsApp connection by integrating the **Meta API** alongside the unofficial one, and moved incoming messages to queues so webhooks respond faster.
Unified WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger in a single inbox, so the team handles every channel without switching tools.
Built WhatsApp marketing and notification campaigns with Meta-approved templates, segmenting the audience by interest, product or spreadsheet.
funcionalidades: WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger in a single inbox.
Multiple connections and queues per department, with many agents.
Voice calls over WhatsApp.
24/7 automated service with menus and auto-replies.
Bulk campaigns and messages with approved templates.
Full customer history in every conversation.
AI agent that triages and hands off to a human when needed.
Real-time service metrics.
Assistant that reads the client’s documentation and sets up the automations.
Products and space rentals, with an API for external systems.
Self-service plan sign-up with online payment.
